long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: I claimed the clay bank already, and I want to see whether anything else has turned up there.
With empty paws I can take one more piece of clay and put it with the rest.
Things I keep ought to be where I can see them, so the clay goes in the house.
I have a clay bowl and a dish already, and the workbench is where I can make something from the clay.
I will try shaping the clay into something worth keeping, though I am not yet good at it.
From the lookout rock I can see the whole beach, and I prefer high places.

today.reason: My curiosity is full and the clay has a purpose, so I will gather it, put it away, and try shaping it at the workbench.
